units.source_text: 苗子一大早心情就不平静，

en.t: From early morning, Naeko felt unsettled,

units.source_text: 她比约定时间提前半个钟头就到达御所西边的蛤御门阴凉处等候秀男。

en.t: and she arrived half an hour before the appointed time at the shade by Hamaguri Gate on the west side of the Imperial Palace, where she waited for Hideo.

units.source_text: 在她来说，等候男子这还是头一回。

en.t: For her, this was the first time she had ever waited for a man.
